trigger: Run only if the normalized-terminal-RLOO third-screen suite completes with exact coverage and zero inference errors and fails its predeclared joint +2.0 pp SR/SPL gate. Do not interrupt or duplicate that suite.
method: Qwen2.5-VL-3B actor-critic PPO with masked token-level GAE and a separately initialized multimodal scalar value head
training_feedback: R2R simulator terminal outcome only; no geodesic progress, reference path, or semantic verifier reward
critic_initialization: same SFT checkpoint with independent scalar LM head, normal weight std 0.001 and zero bias
gpu_plan: physical 0,1 actor/rollout; physical 2 Habitat; physical 3 critic; verify actual Ray mapping and memory before training

source_patch_amendments.reason: A synthetic GPU forward through the actual patched Verl loader exposed a BF16 hidden-state versus FP32 new-head dtype mismatch. The scalar head is now constructed in torch_dtype. No GAE training or navigation outcome existed when amended.

Static trainer validation used trainer.n_gpus_per_node=3 for actor batch divisibility even when one GPU was allocated to a separate critic. It now validates against the two actor GPUs and one critic GPU separately. No GAE training or navigation outcome existed when amended.

launcher_amendments.reason: The first conditional GAE Habitat startup failed before any GAE optimizer step because port 5060 was already owned by an unrelated s2m2 Hypercorn service. The isolated GAE service and trainer now use verified-free port 5075 and fail early if it becomes occupied. No model, data, reward, budget, or evaluation rule changed. The original failure log is retained.

preflight_gate: isolated source copy; patch and import check; real two-step environment rollout; exact action/observation and reward-mask audit; finite critic value and nonzero actor/critic gradients; no OOM; no evaluation before this gate passes

evaluation_integrity_amendments.reason: Before any GAE navigation evaluation, add an independent fail-closed raw per-episode recount before writing suite.completed. The existing post-completion verify_gae_raw.py remains unchanged and must independently agree. This only strengthens evaluation completion semantics; the frozen manifest, reward, budget, metric formulas, and +2/+2 point gate do not change.

advance_gate: both paired SR and paired SPL >= +2.0 percentage points versus the same-seed control, both arms 778 exact unique IDs, zero inference errors, independently recounted from per-episode stats
scale_if_pass: three matched seeds, 512 train rows and 128 optimizer steps at n=4; candidates and existing controls evaluated on the same full 1839 val-unseen manifest before pairing
limitations: All 778 val-seen episodes overlap earlier development screens; this is an adaptive development comparison, not an independent test. Full val-unseen has also been used in prior method development. One seed/decode cannot establish robust or deployable navigation gain.
